### The Sukkot to Come
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/sukkot-come
Passage: Zechariah 14:16-19
Points:
- Post-exilic Israel renewed the Feast of Booths to commemorate God's deliverance and guidance during the wilderness wanderings.
- Zechariah prophesied an ultimate restoration where survivors across all Gentile nations will join together to worship the Lord of hosts.
- The global celebration of Sukkot portrays God extending salvation beyond ethnic boundaries to graft Gentiles into His covenant community.
- Withholding life-giving rain from those who refuse to worship shows that true spiritual blessing requires submitting to Israel's Lord.
- Believers are called to respond with gratitude and humility for God's sovereign mercy in redeeming them.
